name: web-frosted-glass-card-green-wavy-ribbon-background
title: 'Frosted Style Is The Latest Phase of Design' card over glowing green wavy ribbon shapes
whatItIs: A dark background with glowing green wavy ribbon shapes flowing diagonally, overlaid by a large frosted-glass rounded rectangle card with white text stating the design trend, an asterisk icon, resolution and dimension labels, and an arrow indicating scale.
whatItMeans: Premium and on-trend; a frosted glass card over a glowing ribbon shows the glassmorphism effect in its ideal habitat.
techniques: Layer a frosted glass card over a vivid glowing background.
Label technical specs (resolution, dimensions) directly on a template asset.
Use flowing ribbon shapes to give a glass card something to refract.
